skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply methods for collecting information, analyzing, and diagnosing business operations to evaluate business value.
Master the process and methods for evaluating business value and special assets owned by the business.
Master techniques for determining the cost of capital according to international standards and Vietnamese legal regulations.
Apply methods for evaluating business value in practice.
Apply methods for evaluating business value according to Vietnamese valuation standards.
Participate in group discussions and presentations to analyze and evaluate business value.
Analyze and evaluate business value using critical thinking skills.
Present findings and analysis in a structured and logical manner.
Conduct research and gather data to support business valuation analysis.
Solve business valuation problems using analytical and critical thinking skills.
